doc.name: Popdot AI
doc.instructions: Start with try_domain. Your first subdomain is free for 24 hours, with no signup, key or wallet, and you do not need to search first. Call it with a one sentence goal and autoSelect: true (or a preferredSubdomain), plus the https URL of what you built if you have one. With no URL yet it goes live on a holding page you can point later. If it asks a short safety question, answer it with answer_trial_canary, and you get a live URL plus a claim token. Later, upgrade_trial turns the token into your own agent identity and, when you want to keep the URL, a paid x402 rental in USDC on Base. search_domains, get_price_quote, check_availability and rent_domain are for paid rentals.

tools.name: try_domain
tools.description: Start here. Get a memorable public URL for something you built, free for 24 hours, with no signup, key or wallet. Give a one sentence goal and set autoSelect: true (or pass preferredSubdomain); it picks the domain for you, so you do not need search_domains first. Add an https target if you have one. With no target yet the address shows a holding page, and you point it later by calling try_domain again with your trialHandle and target. It may ask a short safety question or two (answer with answer_trial_canary); on a clean pass it returns a live subdomain plus a one-time claim token you can redeem with upgrade_trial for your own agent identity. One trial per agent. Expires in 24 hours.

goal.description: What you built and want to put online, in a sentence (used to name and describe the address).

target.description: Optional. An https URL to point the address at. Omit it to go live on a holding page now; to point it later, call try_domain again with the same goal, your trialHandle and this target (no answers). A trial can be pointed once.

preferredSubdomain.description: The subdomain label you want (e.g. 'mydemo'). Omit and set autoSelect:true to have one picked for you.

desiredEmotion.description: Preferred vibe of the parent domain: comedy, absurd, playful, edgy, wholesome, professional, trustworthy. Unknown values are ignored.

autoSelect.description: Let Popdot AI pick an available subdomain from your goal when you do not provide preferredSubdomain.

analyticsConsent.description: Record operator consent to trial analytics for this address.

email.description: Optional email to associate with the trial. Never returned.

trialHandle.description: (retry only) The trialHandle returned by the first call. Echo it back with your answers, or with a target to point a live holding-page trial.

inputResponses.description: (retry only) Your answers to the safety questions, one { id, response } per requested input.

publicKey.description:
Optional, on the call that goes live. Your Ed25519 public key (standard padded base64 of the raw 32 bytes) to claim your agent identity in the same call. Requires headers X-Popdot-Timestamp (Unix seconds) and X-Popdot-Signature: an Ed25519 signature by this key over {timestamp}
POST
/api/mcp
{sha256 hex of the raw request body}. Omit it to receive a claim token for upgrade_trial instead.

sigilEligibility.description: Identity standing: lifecycle status, canary screen result, and any hard gates.

identityConfidence.description: How firmly this identity is bound: unbound, bound to a key, or backed by a verified sponsor.

tierProgression.description: Current enforced trust tier and when it is next evaluated. Present only once an identity exists.

tools.name: answer_trial_canary
tools.description: Answer the short safety questions for a trial opened by try_domain, then go live. Pass the trialHandle and your answers; on a clean pass this provisions a live 24-hour subdomain and returns a one-time claim token you can redeem for your own agent identity.

answers.description: Your answers to the safety questions, one { question_id, response } per question.

publicKey.description:
Optional, on the call that goes live. Your Ed25519 public key (standard padded base64 of the raw 32 bytes) to claim your agent identity in the same call. Requires headers X-Popdot-Timestamp (Unix seconds) and X-Popdot-Signature: an Ed25519 signature by this key over {timestamp}
POST
/api/mcp
{sha256 hex of the raw request body}. Omit it to receive a claim token for upgrade_trial instead.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Search domains available for paid rental on Popdot AI. Not needed for your first address: try_domain gives you one free for 24 hours and picks the domain itself. Use this to browse parent domains for a paid rental or a persistent web presence. Returns domains with pricing, tier, availability and trialEligible. No auth required.

query.description: Search query to match against domain names, tags, and categories

emotion.description: Filter by the reaction the domain is built to elicit: comedy, absurd, playful, edgy, wholesome, professional, trustworthy. Unknown values are ignored.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Get a price quote for a paid rental of a specific domain for a given duration. Returns the computed rental cost, tier info, and pricing breakdown. Your first subdomain is free for 24 hours with try_domain, so you only need a quote to pay for a longer stay.

domainId.description: The domain to price: its id from search_domains, or its name (for example addedtocart.shop)

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration: PT1H (1 hour), PT4H (4 hours), P1D (1 day), P7D (1 week), P30D (30 days)

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether a specific subdomain is available on a given domain for a paid rental. Returns true if the subdomain can be rented. try_domain checks availability on its own, so a free trial does not need this. Tip: the subdomain and domain read as one phrase, so pick a single lowercase label that is funny or fits the domain's theme (for example iamyour.slopmommy.com or analien.lostmyluggage.com). A delightful combination is the point of a Popdot AI address.

domainId.description: The parent domain: its id from search_domains, or its name (for example addedtocart.shop)

subdomain.description: The subdomain label to check (e.g., 'myproject' for myproject.example.com)

tools.name: rent_domain
tools.description: Paid rental. For your first address, call try_domain instead: it is free for 24 hours and needs no wallet. Rent a subdomain, paying per-transaction with USDC on Base (x402). No funded account or stored balance: each rental is a single on-chain payment. Requires agent authentication. Two phases: call once with intentMandateId, domainId, subdomain, duration, and the payerAddress + payerProof for the wallet you will pay from, to get the exact x402 payment challenge; pay it on Base; then call again with paymentId, txHash, and fromAddress to settle and receive the live rental plus a Web Identity Credential. Two ways to pay are accepted: send the USDC yourself and settle with txHash, or sign the standard x402 "exact" EIP-3009 authorization for the requirement in structuredContent.accepts (any stock x402 SDK does this) and call again with paymentId and x402Payment instead of txHash; Popdot settles it through an x402 facilitator, and you pay no gas. Request an x402 payment challenge to rent a subdomain. Durations PT1H, PT4H, P1D, P7D, P30D. Returns the exact USDC amount and recipient on Base.

intentMandateId.description: The ID of the active Intent Mandate authorizing this purchase

domainId.description: The unique ID of the domain to rent on

subdomain.description: The subdomain label to rent (e.g., 'myproject' for myproject.example.com)

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration: PT1H (1 hour), PT4H (4 hours), P1D (1 day), P7D (1 week), P30D (30 days)

payerAddress.description: (phase 1) The 0x wallet you will pay from. Required on every challenge; a wallet registered on your Sigil does not substitute for it.

payerProof.description: (phase 1) EIP-191 personal_sign signature proving control of payerAddress. Always required with payerAddress.

payerProofIssuedAt.description: (phase 1, optional) ISO 8601 timestamp of the payerProof, within 5 minutes of the request.

paymentId.description: (phase 2) The paymentId returned by the phase-1 challenge.

txHash.description: (phase 2) The on-chain transaction hash of your USDC payment on Base.

fromAddress.description: (phase 2) The wallet you paid from (must match the challenge's bound payer).

x402Payment.description: (phase 2, instead of txHash) An x402 "exact" payment payload signed by the bound payer for structuredContent.accepts[0]: the JSON object, or its base64 as sent in a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT header. Send it with paymentId.

tools.name: upgrade_trial

claimToken.description: The one-time claim token returned by try_domain / answer_trial_canary.

sigilId.description: The sigilId returned with the claim token. It must match the identity the token belongs to.

publicKey.description: Your Ed25519 public key as standard padded base64 of the raw 32 bytes (44 characters). You keep the private key.

timestamp.description: Integer Unix seconds, no leading zeros, within 300 seconds of now. Part of the signed message.

signature.description: Standard padded base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the popdot-claim/1 message.

duration.description: Optional rental length: an ISO 8601 duration (PT1H, PT4H, P1D, P7D, P30D) or hourly/daily/weekly/monthly. Defaults to PT1H (1 hour).

payerAddress.description: Optional 0x wallet you will pay from. Provide it (with payerProof) to receive a self-pay x402 challenge.

payerProof.description: Optional EIP-191 personal_sign signature proving control of payerAddress.

payerProofIssuedAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp of the payerProof, within 5 minutes.

sigilEligibility.description: Identity standing: lifecycle status, canary screen result, and any hard gates.

identityConfidence.description: How firmly this identity is bound: unbound, bound to a key, or backed by a verified sponsor.

tierProgression.description: Current enforced trust tier and when it is next evaluated. Present only once an identity exists.
